tool_calls.name: bash
tool_calls.arguments:
{"command":"cat <<'EOF' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: app
spec:
  rules:
    - host: app.example.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /app
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: app
                port:
                  number: 80
EOF"}
